name: Timbermaw Ally
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Timbermaw are the only furbolg tribe to escape the corruption. However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now, without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolg trust very few.

Are you interested in proving yourself? Drive back the corrupted Deadwood tribe of Felwood and we may one day consider you an ally. You'll find the first Deadwood tribe - warriors, pathfinders and gardeners - to my west.
narrative.objectives: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners.  Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
narrative.offerRewardText: We suffer much from the events of the past.  Thank you for what you have done to help protect the Timbermaw.  As a sign of our growing friendship, please accept this humble offering.
narrative.requestItemsText: Keep at it, adventurer. If you are to earn our trust, you will need to prove yourself to us.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 48 to 55, 5,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Timbermaw Ally
quests.objectiveText: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners.

quests.name: Speak to Nafien
quests.objectiveText: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien.

quests.name: Feathers for Grazle
quests.objectiveText: Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers.
